name: Deep Space 1
about: Deep Space 1 (1998-061A, NASA/JPL), launched 1998 Oct 24. Its phases from GCAT: Braille, HCO. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
